title: Reading Drill — Sorting bricks for reuse — A pilot study
description: One short passage, six questions. Recommended time: 10 minutes.

passages.title: Sorting bricks for reuse — A pilot study
passages.body:
**A** A project in Bramley began with reports of reusable bricks being mixed with cracked pieces. The site supervisor had heard several complaints, but individual reports could not show how often the problem occurred. The team collected evidence using sample checks and chose the proportion of intact bricks recovered as its main measure. That allowed it to compare different days using the same rule.

**B** The proposed response was sorting before transport. Rather than apply it immediately across the whole site, the team ran a trial in a single area. The trial lasted three weeks. A second area kept its previous arrangements, making it possible to see whether any change occurred at both sites.

**C** The first review recorded mortar left on the bricks as a factor that could affect the comparison. The team advised repeating the study under different conditions before drawing a wider conclusion. It kept the evidence from the first trial but published a note about why the figures might not apply elsewhere.
